summary.text: Chris Bechtold is the Democratic candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 17, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Justin Cleveland; no incumbent is seeking the seat.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as rancher.

paragraphs.text: Chris Bechtold earned a high school diploma from Alton High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Montana in 1993.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired ranch manager and small business owner in Choteau who has a biology degree, raised four children in the Choteau school system, and has spent 33 years along the Rocky Mountain Front working as a mule packer, guide, rancher and small businessman.
Bechtold advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026, receiving 631 votes as the only candidate on the ballot.

In the survey, he listed three key messages: representing working Montanans rather than out-of-state interests, providing a future for young people so they can stay in Montana, and responsible stewardship of water and land.
He named natural resources and tax equality as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
